beats.label: S1 · The swap
beats.text: Jason #02 abducts Jason #01 outside a Chicago bar, injects him with an unknown compound, and slips into his life with wife Daniela and son Charlie.
beats.whyLoadBearing: Establishes the swap that drives every other beat: two Jasons now occupy two worlds.

beats.label: S1 · Wrong life, wrong lab
beats.text: Jason #01 wakes at Velocity Labs where strangers treat him as a returning hero. He finds Daniela, but Velocity's Dawn murders her and drags him back.
beats.whyLoadBearing: Reveals Velocity as a hostile institution and shows what fate awaits #01 if he cannot escape.

beats.label: S1 · Into the box
beats.text: Studying Jason #02's research, #01 learns the box lets a traveler cross into parallel realities. He and lab psychiatrist Amanda flee inside it together.
beats.whyLoadBearing: Introduces the central mechanism of the show and pairs #01 with Amanda for his journey home.

beats.label: S1 · The corridor
beats.text: The box opens onto an infinite corridor of doors that respond to the traveler's mind. #01 and Amanda land in one ruined world after another, unable to steer.
beats.whyLoadBearing: Names the rule the whole series turns on: your emotional state chooses the world you enter.

beats.label: S1 · Daniela sees through him
beats.text: In #01's world, Daniela grows suspicious after a nut-allergy scare, finds Jason #02's ampoules, and #02 strands Ryan in another Chicago to bury the secret.
beats.whyLoadBearing: Marks the moment Daniela stops trusting her husband — the pivot that lets her later choose #01.

beats.label: S1 · Home, and not alone
beats.text: Amanda stays behind in a progressive Chicago; #01 spends his last ampoule and finally reaches his own world — where dozens of other Jasons have also arrived.
beats.whyLoadBearing: Detonates the season's core twist: the corridor produced many #01s, and all of them want Daniela.

beats.label: S1 · She chooses one
beats.text: Daniela picks Jason #01. Jason #02 helps the family flee the swarm of rivals, and the Dessens step through a corridor door into a reality they choose themselves.
beats.whyLoadBearing: Resolves the swap emotionally while launching the family into the multiverse as fugitives.

cliffhanger.text: The Dessens vanish through a corridor door into an unfamiliar reality, hunted by the ghosts of every Jason who wanted them. Leighton has followed them into the box, and in the progressive Chicago where Amanda stayed, Ryan is trying to synthesise the compound on his own.
questions: Where do the Dessens land, and can they build a life that finally stays theirs?
What will Leighton do with the corridor now that he is inside it?
Why is Ryan recreating the compound, and what does he want with Amanda?

characters.name: Jason Dessen (#01)
characters.line: The original Chicago physics professor, now stepping into an unknown world with the family he fought a version of himself to reclaim.

characters.name: Daniela Dessen
characters.line: Jason's wife and a painter, who saw through the impostor, chose #01, and now flees with him through the multiverse.

characters.name: Charlie Dessen
characters.line: Their teenage son, aware his father was replaced and traveling the corridor alongside his parents.

characters.name: Jason #02
characters.line: The alternate Jason who abducted #01 and took his life; ultimately helped the Dessens escape rather than keep them.

characters.name: Amanda Lucas
characters.line: Velocity's lab psychiatrist who escaped the box with #01, then chose to stay behind in a progressive alternate Chicago.

characters.name: Leighton Vance
characters.line: Velocity's CEO in Jason #01's world; entered the box himself at season's end and is now loose inside the corridor.
